excluded_categories.tweet_offensive: Explicitly excluded by the user on 2026-09-27 because its full-text TweetEval/OLID items have unresolved X policy permissions. Exclusion is applied before normalization for every matrix row.

task_mapping.choice: Preserve criteria option IDs and non-empty labels; when an upstream category descriptor is null, use its stable option ID as the display label. Preserve the correct option ID.
task_mapping.noul: Convert the boolean task to a two-option choice with stable true/false IDs. Preserve upstream option descriptions when provided; otherwise use Yes/No. Convert the boolean gold label to its true/false option ID.
task_mapping.score: Convert each ordered rubric entry to a string option ID equal to its zero-based position; convert the integer gold label to that option ID.

candidate_contract: Every included source row maps to one ordered bounded choice request. All six pinned candidates expose choice inference; common input feasibility is established by exact per-candidate tokenizer preflight before outputs.
